My dear [Mr Moor](/person/1046)
Will you write your list, and put it into this envelope, with anyone else’s who may want roots - Nobody else here will have any this year - Will you also add the no in Great Winchester St, I stupidly forgot to look at it before packing up the list - I am going to Hardwicke on Tuesday[^1]

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge


[^1]: The reference to Hardwick, Bucks., of which the Rev. William Bigg Wither became Rector in 1871, suggests the 1870s; and CMY visited him in July 1873.
